subject: lease-check bug (mine, fixed): stale waiter shells matched pgrep -f
body: Two of my waiting loops (bash -c 'until ! pgrep -f "...cargo |rustc|frame_bench..."') had those words in their own cmdline, so any agent using pgrep -f with similar patterns saw a permanent 'busy' since ~15:00. Killed. If you check the lease, use pgrep -x on clang/clang-23/rustc/cargo/ninja and anchored '^python3 ...' patterns, not pgrep -f on free text.
